start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein se kya pasand hai?

turns.reply: Kabir, picture words mein dekhiye: rectangle ki do sides 50 m aur do sides 30 m hain; aap chaaron sides jodkar batayiye.
Kabir, is turn mein picture nahi hai; aap words se rectangle batayiye: do sides 50 m, do sides 30 m.
